function whileLoop<T extends 'a' | 'b'>(x: T, y: T) {
  if (x === 'a') {
    let count = 0;
    while (count < 2) {
      const current: 'a' = x;
      console.log(current);
      x = y;
      count++;
    }
  }
}

function forLoop<T extends 'a' | 'b'>(x: T, y: T) {
  if (x === 'a') {
    for (let count = 0; count < 2; count++) {
      const current: 'a' = x;
      console.log(current);
      x = y;
    }
  }
}

function nestedLoop<T extends 'a' | 'b'>(x: T, y: T) {
  if (x === 'a') {
    let count = 0;
    do {
      for (let inner = 0; inner < 1; inner++) {
        const current: 'a' = x;
        console.log(current);
      }
      x = y;
      count++;
    } while (count < 2);
  }
}

whileLoop<'a' | 'b'>('a', 'b');
forLoop<'a' | 'b'>('a', 'b');
nestedLoop<'a' | 'b'>('a', 'b');

function narrowedEachIteration<T extends 'a' | 'b'>(x: T, y: T) {
  let count = 0;
  while (x === 'a' && count < 2) {
    const current: 'a' = x;
    console.log(current);
    x = y;
    count++;
  }
}

narrowedEachIteration<'a' | 'b'>('a', 'b');
